Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: McClendon
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 214 as introduced would codify existing practice of the Alabama State Council on the Arts to: (1) provide grants, programs, and services to support the states art community; and (2) provide honorariums to advisory panelists in the amount of $150, as compensation for services provided in reviewing grant applications. According to the Council, the amount paid to panelists in FY 2021 was $13,350. However, the total amount paid annually could increase or decrease depending upon the number of panelists evaluating grants, but would not exceed a maximum of $30,000.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: McClendon
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 214 as passed the Senate would codify existing practice of the Alabama State Council on the Arts to: (1) provide grants, programs, and services to support the states art community; and (2) award honorariums without regard to current competitive bid law. According to the Council, $13,350 was paid to panelists for honorariums in FY 2021 and the total amount paid annually is not estimated to exceed $30,000.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
